cases.study_information: Predict ofaschlupfer total clearance (mL/h/kg) after a single 30 mg/kg IV dose in cynomolgus monkeys. Matched human receptor-binding results, a qualitative HIC comparison and the bimagrumab clearance reference are visible. Target AUC, Vss, half-life and other algebraic clearance proxies are withheld. Each group contained two animals; predict the reported finite-cohort mean.

dependence_note: Shared experimental family; count in original-family sensitivity aggregation, not as independent biological replication.
title: Predicting cynomolgus clearance of a dual ActRII antibody
